senses.gloss: निब(व)र्हण n. Killing, destruction, annihilation, Na.i.131.
निवचने ind. Not speaking; (it is considered either as a prefix or as a separate word, hence निवचने कृत्वा or निवचनेकृत्य.
निवपन n. 1. Scattering or throwing down; 2. sowing; 3. an offering to the Manes, को नः कुले निवपनानि नियच्छतीति Sak.vi.
निवरा f. A virgin, an unmarried girl.
निवार m. 1. Keeping off, preventing, hindering, दंशनिवारणैश्च R.xi.5; 2. prohibition, impediment.
नीवर m. 1. Trade, traffic; 2. a trader; 3. a religious mendicant; 4. mud, mire.
नीवार m. Rice growing wild or without cultivation, नीवाराः शुकगर्भकोटरमुखभ्रष्टास्तरुणामधः Sak.i., R.i.50, v.9.
निवर्तक a. (f. का) 1. Returning, turning back; 2. stopping, seizing; 3. abolishing, expelling.
निवर्तक a. (f. का) 1. Returning, turning back; 2. stopping, seizing; 3. abolishing, expelling.

निवर्तन n. 1. Returning, turning back, इह हि पततां नास्त्यालंबो न चापि निवर्तनम् Sant.S.iii.2; 2. not happening, ceasing; 3. desisting from a work, inactivity; 4. repenting; 5. a measure of land equal to 20 rods.
निवसति f. Residence, house, habitation.
निवसथ m. A village.
निवसन n. 1. A house, a habitation; 2. a garment, R.xix.41.
निवासन n. Residing, sojourn.
निवह m. 1. A multitude, a quantity, म्लेच्छनिवहनिधने कलयसि करवालम् Git.G.i.; 2. one of the seven courses of wind.
निवात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Protected against the wind, not windy, calm, R.xix.42; 2. unhurt, uninjured; 3. secure, safe; 4. accoutred in strong mail.
निवात (II) m. 1. An asylum, a refuge; 2. an impenetrable coat of mail.
निवात (III) n. 1. A place sheltered from the wind, निवातपद्मस्थिमितेन चक्षुसा R.iii.17, xiii.52, K.S.iii.48, Bg.vi.19; 2. a secure spot; 3. a strong armour.
निवात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Protected against the wind, not windy, calm, R.xix.42; 2. unhurt, uninjured; 3. secure, safe; 4. accoutred in strong mail.
निवाप m. 1. Seed, grain; 2. an oblation to the deceased parents or relatives, an offering at the śrāddha, निवापांजलिदनेन Ve.iii., निवापदत्तिभिः R.viii.86, v.8, xv.91; 3. a gift in general.
निवारण n. 1. Keeping off, prerenting, hindering, दंशनिवारणैश्च R.xi.5; 2. prohibition, impediment.
निवास m. 1. Living, dwelling; 2. passing the night; 3. abode, house, resting place, Sis.iv.63, Bg.ix.18; 4. dress.
निवि(बि)ड a. (f. डा) 1. Without space or interstices, close; 2. firm, fast, R.ix.58, xix.44; 3. thick, impervious, dense, R.xi.15; 4. crooked-nosed.
निवि(बि)ड a. (f. डा) 1. Without space or interstices, close; 2. firm, fast, R.ix.58, xix.44; 3. thick, impervious, dense, R.xi.15; 4. crooked-nosed.
निविरीस a. (f. सा) 1. Compact, close, उरुनिविरीसनितंबभारखेदि Sis.viii.20; 2. coarse; 3. crooked-nosed.
निविरीस a. (f. सा) 1. Compact, close, उरुनिविरीसनितंबभारखेदि Sis.viii.20; 2. coarse; 3. crooked-nosed.
निविशेष (I) a. (f. षा) Not different, alike.
निविशेष (II) m. Want of difference.
निविशेष (I) a. (f. षा) Not different, alike.
निविष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Seated, sitting upon; 2. fixed on. intent upon; 3. initiated; 4. arranged.
निविष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Seated, sitting upon; 2. fixed on. intent upon; 3. initiated; 4. arranged.
निवीत (I) n. 1. Wearing the sacred thread round the neck like a garland; 2. the thread so worn.
निवीत (II) m.n. A veil, a mantle.
निवृत (I) a. (f. ता) Surrounded, enclosed.
निवृत (II) m.n. A veil, a mantle.
निवृत (I) a. (f. ता) Surrounded, enclosed.
निवृत्त a. (f. त्ता) 1. Returned, turned back; 2. gone, departed; 3. ceased, refrained from; 4. abstracted from this world; 5. finished, completed, (pp. of वृत् with नि q.v.).
निवृत्त a. (f. त्ता) 1. Returned, turned back; 2. gone, departed; 3. ceased, refrained from; 4. abstracted from this world; 5. finished, completed, (pp. of वृत् with नि q.v.).
निवृति f. Covering, enclosing.

निवृत्ति f. 1. Returning, return, R.iv.87; 2. disappearance, cessation, suspension, R.viii.82; 3. aversion, abstaining from, M.v.56; 4. cessation of worldly acts or emotions, separation from the world; 5. repose, rest; 6. felicity, beatitude; 7. refusal; 8. abolition, prevention.
निवृत्त-आत्मन् m. 1. a sage; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
निवृत्त-कारण (I) a. without further cause or motive.
निवृत्त-कारण (II) m. a virtuous man, a man uninfluenced by worldly desires.
निवृत्त-मांस a. one who abstains from eating meat.
निवृत्त-राग a. of subdued appetite or passions.
निवृत्त-वृत्ति a. quitting any practice or occupation.
निवृत्त-हृदय a. with relenting heart.
निवेदन n. 1. Proclaiming, relating. announcement; 2. delivering, entrusting; 3. representation; 4. an offering, oblation; 5. dedication.
निवेद्य n. Offering food to an idol. (Cf. नैवेद्य.)

निवेश m. 1. Entering, entrance; 2. encamping, halting; 3. camp, encampment, R.v.49, vii.2; 4. a house, an abode; 5. depositing, delivering; 6. marrying, marriage; 7. impression, copy; 8. military array; 9. ornaments decoration.
निवेशन n. 1. Entering, entrance; 2. a house, an abode; 3. a camp; 4. a town.
निवेष्ट m. A cover, an envelope.
निवेष्टन n. Covering, enveloping.
नीध्र(व्र) n. 1. The edge of a roof; 2. a wood; 3. the circumference of a wheel; 4. the moon.
नीवाक m. Increased demand for grain in times of dearth, famine, scarcity.

नीवि f. 1. A cloth worn round a woman’s waist or the ends of it tied in front, the knot of a wearing garment, नीवीबंधोच्छ्वसनमधरस्पंदनं दोर्विषादः M.M.ii., K.S.i.38, vii.60; 2. capital, principal, stock; 3. a stake, a wager.

नीवि f. 1. A cloth worn round a woman’s waist or the ends of it tied in front, the knot of a wearing garment, नीवीबंधोच्छ्वसनमधरस्पंदनं दोर्विषादः M.M.ii., K.S.i.38, vii.60; 2. capital, principal, stock; 3. a stake, a wager.
नीवृत् m. Any inhabited country.
